chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from one of his companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding a man who goes to the brother of his wife, he (peace be upon him) said: 'If he penetrates him, then the wife is prohibited to him.'

key_terms.أَوْقَبَهُ: He penetrated him (specifically referring to sexual intercourse)

ai.seo_question: What is the legal consequence if a man has intercourse with his wife's brother?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the mechanism of 'Habl min al-Habl' (kinship by marriage) in Shia fiqh, establishing that sexual intercourse with a wife's brother creates a permanent prohibition for the husband. It highlights the juristic principle that the act renders the wife 'haram' not merely due to the marital bond, but specifically because of the new kinship link formed with her brother, a key distinction in determining validity of subsequent marriages.
